# 3Dmol.js

Vendored official 3Dmol.js 2.5.3 browser build from the existing locked npm package, unchanged.

- Upstream: https://github.com/3dmol/3Dmol.js
- Release: https://github.com/3dmol/3Dmol.js/releases/tag/2.5.3
- License: BSD-3-Clause; original project and bundled notices are preserved alongside this file.
- This package builds the library into its offline viewer. It does not load a CDN or use the host application's JavaScript.
